errors.network: We could not reach MediLink. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {{seconds}} seconds, then try again.
errors.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.sessionExpired: You were logged out. Log in again to continue.
errors.loadFailed: We could not load your account.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter an email address in the correct format, like name@example.rw
validation.termsRequired: Accept the terms of use to create an account
validation.privacyRequired: Accept the privacy notice to create an account

landing.title: Find care in Rwanda
landing.heroBody: Find a health facility that accepts your insurance, book, and arrive when it is your turn.

search.title: Find care
search.comingSoon: Search opens soon. Until then, ask at your health facility.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Search by service, place and insurance. See which facilities accept your insurance.
how.step2Body: Choose a time, or join today’s queue from your phone.
how.step3Body: Follow your place in the queue. We tell you when to leave home.

trust.title: Your data stays in Rwanda
trust.body: Your information is encrypted, stored in Rwanda, and shared only with the facilities that care for you.

facilities.title: For health facilities
facilities.body: Run your queue, records and billing in one place, and let patients find you.

emergency.title: Emergency?
emergency.body: Go to the nearest emergency department or call 912. MediLink is not for emergencies.

login.title: Log in or create an account
login.intro: Book care and skip the long wait.
login.createAccount: Create an account with this email
login.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not right. Check them and try again.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: It takes about a minute. You can add insurance and family members later.
signup.passwordHint: Use at least 15 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
signup.languageHint: We send reminders and messages in this language.
signup.consentIntro: Before we create your account, please read this:
signup.consentPoint1: Your health information is encrypted and stored in Rwanda.
signup.consentPoint2: Only the facilities that care for you can see your records.
signup.consentPoint3: You can download your data or delete your account at any time.
signup.terms: I accept the terms of use
signup.privacy: I have read the privacy notice and agree to how MediLink uses my information
signup.research: I agree that my anonymised data may be used for health research
signup.researchHint: Optional. Saying no changes nothing about your care. You can change this later.

home.title: Home
home.intro: What would you like to do today?
home.nextVisitEmpty: No visits yet. When you book or join a queue, it will show here.
home.verifyEmailBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Confirm your email before you can see your health records.

verify.title: Verify a document
verify.body: Soon pharmacies and employers can check a prescription, receipt or sick note here with its code or QR.

forFacilities.title: MediLink for health facilities
forFacilities.body: Facility registration opens in the next release. You will be able to apply online and go live after verification.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: The full terms of use will be published here before launch, in Kinyarwanda, English and French.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: The full privacy notice will be published here before launch, in Kinyarwanda, English and French.

help.title: Help
help.body: Guides for patients and caregivers are coming. No smartphone? Ask at reception.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the address, or go back to the home page.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.hint: At least 15 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
reset.doneBody: Your password was changed and you were logged out everywhere. Log in with your new password.
reset.invalidLink: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.
